{{Top|leg}}
The '''Encumbered''' was a term used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] to refer to his subjects in the [[Daimanate]]. The narcissistic Sith Lord believed that he was the creator of the [[Galaxy/Legends|universe]] and that all other sentient beings and creatures were soulless automatons created by his will. The Encumbered were burdened with the functions and orders that he had assigned them with. He also regarded all his subjects as mere extensions of his will.
